is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles gambiae (s.l.) mosquitoes, specifically An. gambiae (s.s.) and An. coluzzii.

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper reports genotyping for Vgsc L995F (kdr-west, 1014F) and Vgsc L995S (kdr-east, 1014S) in Tables 2 and 3.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Tables 2 and 3 provide genotype counts (RR, RS, SS) and total sample sizes for L1014F and L1014S.

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected as larvae from the field in Yaoundé, Cameroon.

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical study reporting original field collections and bioassay/genotyping data.

sub_country_location.evidence: The study specifies 32 districts in Yaoundé, Cameroon, and provides a map (Fig. 1).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The study covers a 3-year monitoring period (2017–2019).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study describes new collections and surveys conducted between 2017 and 2019.

supplement.evidence: All necessary genotype counts and bioassay data are provided in the main text tables (Tables 1, 2, 3).

assessment.summary: This study assessed insecticide resistance in Anopheles gambiae (s.l.) populations in Yaoundé, Cameroon, over three years (2017-2019). It combined WHO susceptibility bioassays, PBO synergist tests, and molecular genotyping for kdr mutations (L1014F and L1014S) with surveys of agricultural pesticide usage among local farmers and vendors.
